notes: Single source of truth for platform-specific safe zones (UI occlusion), content-safe zones (important visual elements), and caption-safe zones (text). All coordinates assume canonical resolutions (1080x1920 for 9:16, 1920x1080 for 16:9, 1080x1080 for 1:1, 1080x1350 for 4:5). Use with safe-zones.ts loader in remotion-videos. Platform UI overlays CAN change without notice — re-verify quarterly.

conventions.ui_safe: Rectangles OCCLUDED by platform UI chrome. Never place critical content here.
conventions.content_safe: Recommended inner rectangle where important visual subject should live.
conventions.caption_safe: Narrower inner rectangle where text overlays should live (tighter margins than content_safe to avoid text being clipped or too close to UI).
conventions.action_safe: Outer tolerance zone — content near edges may be cropped on certain devices.
conventions.title_safe: Broadcast-style inner boundary — headlines belong inside this.

bottom.reason: caption, audio pill, CTA, share buttons

top.reason: status bar + For You / Following tabs

bottom.reason: username, caption, music pill, navigation bar

top.reason: status bar + Shorts header + search icon

bottom.reason: title, channel, description, Shorts nav tab
progress bar + controls on hover; end-screen cards spawn from bottom right
progress bar + audio icon on hover
feed UI on native mobile player

face_placement.9:16: Upper third rule — face should sit 25-40% from top. Eye line around y=600 on 1080x1920 canvas. Keeps face clear of bottom UI and hook text.
face_placement.16:9: Rule of thirds intersection — face at either left or right third, eye line at upper horizontal third (y=360 on 1920x1080).
face_placement.1:1: Center-weighted — face centered horizontally, eye line at 40% from top.
face_placement.4:5: Center-weighted — face centered horizontally, eye line at 35% from top.

subject_padding.reasoning: Platform UI can shift by 20-40px across device sizes; 100px padding absorbs this.

text_over_image.hook_text_zone: Upper third of content_safe (above subject's face for faceless talking-heads, below for POV/scene shots)
text_over_image.cta_text_zone: Lower third of content_safe, ABOVE ui_occlusions.bottom + 40px buffer

cross_platform_master.strategy: Master at 1080x1920 (9:16) with ALL critical content inside intersection of content_safe zones for IG Reels, TikTok, YT Shorts, FB Reels. Export secondary crops for 1:1 and 16:9 from same master by center-cropping or reframing.

universal_safe_9x16.reason: Intersection of IG Reels + TikTok + YT Shorts caption_safe zones

letterbox_vs_pillarbox.rule: NEVER letterbox 9:16 content for 16:9 feeds — platforms penalize. Export native aspect for each platform.
letterbox_vs_pillarbox.exception: 16:9 hero compositions can be center-cropped to 9:16 at cost of losing left/right thirds.

motion_within_safe.rule: Animated elements that pan, scale, or transition MUST remain inside content_safe at ALL frames, not just start/end keyframes.
motion_within_safe.reason: Mid-animation bounds are the most common safe-zone violation

caption_specific_rules.contrast: Always include text shadow, stroke, or semi-opaque background behind captions. Platforms auto-compress and low-contrast text disappears.
caption_specific_rules.max_line_length: Aim for 30 characters per line for hook text, 40 for body. Break mid-phrase not mid-word.
caption_specific_rules.burned_in_vs_dynamic: For IG/TikTok/Shorts, burn captions into video (auto-captions are unreliable and visually inconsistent). For YouTube 16:9 longform, upload SRT separately so viewers can toggle.
